subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: When the requester turn completes but required message-tool evidence is missing, should OpenClaw terminally record visible-delivery failure without replaying the requester, or require a separately persisted visible-only retry mechanism?
rationale: Avoiding requester replay prevents duplicate arbitrary side effects, but making the failure terminal can permanently suppress the user-visible completion; source inspection cannot choose that compatibility policy.

options.title: Confirm terminal split
options.body: Accept requester wake as complete, persist visible delivery as failed, and require matching exact-head runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Require visible-only retry
options.body: Pause this PR until a transport-ready persisted envelope can retry visible delivery without rerunning requester orchestration.

options.title: Preserve current retry behavior
options.body: Close or redesign this change if maintainers prefer the existing retry semantics despite requester replay risk.

recommendation.title: Confirm terminal split
recommendation.body: Accept requester wake as complete, persist visible delivery as failed, and require matching exact-head runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to the registry lifecycle and persisted delivery contract where the policy must be owned.
